_about.purpose: A curated index of websites offering free, legally downloadable audio (music, audiobooks, podcasts, educational, historical). Consumed by `open-audio-fetch --catalog`.
_about.note: No single canonical machine-readable index of these sources existed at time of writing; this catalog synthesizes several human-maintained listicles (Open Culture, Hongkiat's CC list, Silverman Sound, etc.) into structured data.

license_key.public-domain: No rights reserved; download and reuse freely.
license_key.creative-commons: Per-track CC licenses; free to download, but honor attribution / non-commercial / share-alike terms for any reuse or redistribution.
license_key.free-personal: Offered free for personal listening (e.g. podcast RSS). Not licensed for redistribution.
license_key.mixed: Contains items under multiple licenses; check per item.
license_key.cc0: No rights reserved (CC0); download and reuse freely.

adapter_status_key.implemented: A working SiteAdapter ships in this repo.
adapter_status_key.planned: On the backlog; not yet implemented.
adapter_status_key.index-only: Aggregator/listicle, not a host; mine it for more sources.
adapter_status_key.experimental: A working SiteAdapter ships, but the source is scrape-fragile or login/quota-gated; treat output as best-effort.

_about.data_license: This catalog data is dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. The audio it points to keeps each source's own license (see each entry).

redistributable_key.conditional: Re-shareable only under the item's CC terms (NC / SA / ND vary per item).
redistributable_key.no: Free to download for personal listening only; do NOT redistribute (e.g. podcast episodes).
redistributable_key.mixed: Varies per item — check each item's recorded rights.

sources.name: Listen to Genius (Redwood Audiobooks)
sources.bulk: Crawl index.php/titles.php -> author.php work pages -> recordings*/*.mp3
sources.notes: Professionally narrated public-domain classics. Modest catalog (hundreds of works).

sources.name: LibriVox
sources.api: https://librivox.org/api/feed/audiobooks (JSON/XML; fields incl. url_zip_file per book)
sources.bulk: API paginates all ~20k books; each book offers a 'zip of entire book' (64kbps MP3) and per-chapter MP3s mirrored on archive.org.
sources.notes: The canonical volunteer public-domain audiobook project. Huge. Mirrored on Internet Archive.

sources.name: Internet Archive — Audio
sources.robots: Has API terms; be gentle, identify yourself. Live Music Archive (etree) is band-sanctioned recordings.
sources.bulk: advancedsearch.php (JSON query) -> metadata API (/metadata/<id>) lists downloadable files -> download via /download/<id>/<file>. Or the `internetarchive` CLI/`ia` tool.
sources.notes: The mega-source. Millions of items. Filter by mediatype:audio and collection. Respect rate limits; prefer the official `ia` client for very large pulls.

sources.name: Free Music Archive (FMA)
sources.robots: Check current robots.txt before crawling; throttle hard.
sources.api: Historically had an API (freemusicarchive.org/api); status varies since ownership change. Scrape track pages as fallback.
sources.bulk: Browse by genre/curator; each track page exposes a direct download when the license allows.
sources.notes: Site is now a JavaScript single-page app; static scraping returns nothing (browse pages 404 / render client-side). Downgraded to planned pending an official API or a headless-render approach. Content is genuinely CC and free.

sources.name: Jamendo Music
sources.robots: API is the sanctioned path; register a client_id and respect quotas.
sources.bulk: API returns track lists with audiodownload URLs; page through by tag/genre/artist.
sources.notes: 600k+ CC tracks from independent artists. Attribution required; some tracks NC.

sources.name: ccMixter
sources.bulk: Query API returns downloadable file URLs with license metadata.
sources.notes: Its query API is the only discovery path, but robots.txt explicitly `Disallow: /api/` — so we cannot enumerate tracks politely. Kept planned; content is genuinely CC but not reachable without violating robots. Do not scrape around it.

sources.name: Musopen
sources.robots: Respect the per-day download cap; do not attempt to bypass it.
sources.bulk: Recording pages expose downloads. FREE ACCOUNT IS RATE-LIMITED to ~5 downloads/day in standard quality — respect this hard limit.
sources.notes: Cloudflare returns 403 to our User-Agent even for robots.txt, which robots parsers treat as disallow-all — so we cannot crawl it politely. Downgraded to planned; do NOT scrape around the block. The ~5/day free cap also applies.

sources.name: Lit2Go (FCIT, Univ. of South Florida)
sources.bulk: Browse by author/book/collection; each passage offers an MP3 + companion PDF.
sources.notes: ~200 teacher-friendly audiobooks with reading levels and PDFs.

sources.name: Loyal Books (formerly Books Should Be Free)
sources.bulk: Catalog in 29 languages; per-book pages list chapter MP3s (largely LibriVox-sourced).
sources.notes: Nicely categorized front-end over public-domain LibriVox audiobooks; chapter MP3s are hosted on archive.org. Verified live 2026-07-26 (homepage -> /book/ pages -> chapter MP3s).

sources.name: LibriVox Collection on Internet Archive
sources.bulk: Query the librivoxaudio collection via advancedsearch, download files via metadata API.
sources.notes: Alternative bulk path to LibriVox content through the IA API.

sources.name: Podcast Index
sources.robots: Open index. Episode audio is the creators' — download for personal listening only, not redistribution.
sources.bulk: Search/feeds endpoints return RSS feed URLs; parse each feed's <enclosure> to fetch episode audio.
sources.notes: Open, free podcast index. Two-stage: index -> feed -> episodes. Respect each show's terms.

sources.name: Library of Congress — National Jukebox / Citizen DJ
sources.api: loc.gov JSON API (append ?fo=json to collection URLs)
sources.bulk: 16k+ early PD recordings; Citizen DJ packages PD samples. Page the JSON API.
sources.notes: Our robots check refuses loc.gov collection/audio JSON paths, and National Jukebox is largely streaming-only under a Sony agreement (few downloadable files, rights per-item). Downgraded to planned; not a polite bulk-download target today.

sources.name: Open Culture
sources.bulk: Aggregator: mostly links out to LibriVox/IA/university sources. Mine it to discover more sources rather than as a host.
sources.notes: Also lists free online courses (audio lectures) worth indexing.

sources.name: Openverse
sources.robots: Open REST API is the sanctioned path; identify yourself.
sources.api: https://api.openverse.org/v1/ (audio endpoint; free, OAuth for higher limits)
sources.bulk: Search /v1/audio across Jamendo, Freesound and Wikimedia Commons; each result links to the original download with its own CC/PD license.
sources.notes: Open REST API, but robots.txt explicitly `Disallow: /v1/audio/` for all bots (and blocks AI crawlers). So despite being an appealing CC meta-source, it is NOT a polite audio-fetch target. Kept planned; do not crawl the audio endpoint.

sources.name: Freesound
sources.robots: API is the sanctioned path; free API key required, login to download.
sources.api: https://freesound.org/docs/api/ (free API key; token to download)
sources.bulk: Text/search API returns sounds with per-sound CC license (CC0 / CC-BY / CC-BY-NC); download via the API.
sources.notes: Collaborative CC sound database (CC0 / CC-BY / CC-BY-NC). Free download for registered users; honor each sound's specific license (NC where present).
